verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs confirm in-person card acceptance through physical readers (Solo, Go) and Tap to Pay contactless acceptance on a phone, so the core in-person axis is delivered. Chip (EMV) is only implied by 'card readers', and Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV support documentation, explicit Apple Pay / Google Pay acceptance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.
Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.
Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.
Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.
